prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one 1536x1024 premium pixel-art DESERT DUNGEON environment design board for Vo Lam Hero Defense. Reference image 1 Bamboo Forest is the PRIMARY quality, elevated orthographic top-down RPG perspective, crisp small pixel clusters and detailed wuxia architecture benchmark. Reference 2 Desert is theme only; REMOVE all its UI and horizon-perspective. This is ancient CHINESE wuxia desert, sandstone ruins, dunes, abandoned Chinese temple, carved cloud fret stonework, broken upturned eaves, red faded banners. NOT Egyptian, Arabian, isometric or side view. Main upper 2/3: orthogonal overhead layout with broad low-contrast combat clearings connected by generous sand and sandstone paths, perimeter cliff outcrops and ruins, small entrance ruin west and cyan exit portal beside it, shallow dunes, dry shrubs and trees. No actors, no UI, no game mechanics. Lower third: organized isolated studies of six terrain materials, broken pillars, ruin wall, gateway, dead tree, crate/barrel, amber sandstone monument, blue exit portal. Warm sand, ochre, russet shadows, muted jade/turquoise accents. Light upper left. Crisp authored pixel clusters, rich layered materials, no blur, no procedural rectangles. One static concept sheet; no giant map intended for runtime. Minimal title 'SA MAC - DESERT' and tiny section captions only.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE 1536x1024 master creature CONCEPT board for six original Sa Mac desert dungeon enemies in premium detailed CHIBI WUXIA PIXEL ART. Reference 1 = approved Bamboo Forest shading/pixel cluster quality and elevated orthographic 3/4 RPG camera. Reference 2 = hero proportions only. Reference 3 = arena enemies to DIFFERENTIATE FROM, do NOT recolor/copy those skeletons/jiangshi/round green golem. Six equally sized panels on parchment, STRICT 3 columns x2 rows, one creature per panel, centered no overlaps. Top left: BO CAP CAT, huge amber armored scorpion, distinct huge pincers, eight legs and high venom tail, low broad silhouette. Top middle: SA XA, sandy viper, dark umber diamond markings, ivory belly, coiled S tail, red forked tongue, no cobra hood. Top right: SA TAC, scruffy tan/brown Chinese desert outlaw, short layered jacket, wrapped calves, rusty red headwrap, exposed face, curved single-edged dao. Bottom left: CUNG THU SA MAC, hooded muted ochre desert archer, compact bow and back quiver, face in shadow, asymmetrical draped scarf. Bottom middle: XAC UOP, small ancient Chinese tomb undead, worn loose ivory bandages, bronze burial token on chest, glowing turquoise eyes, no pharaoh regalia, no jiangshi hat. Bottom right: CU NHAN SA THACH, massive angular sandstone temple guardian, rectangular layered slab shoulders, carved Chinese cloud motifs, glowing AMBER runes, broad stone fists, no green moss and no round boulders. Each panel shows dominant front-down three-quarter pose and small back pose beside it, plus 4 palette swatches. Fixed top-down elevated view with visible head tops and feet planted, crisp pixel outlines, warm brown contour, upper-left lighting, real material detail, not vector, not realistic painting, no gradients, no isometric diamond projection. Small ASCII name caption only. Each creature anatomically distinct. Golem roughly1.6x humanoid, scorpion broad/low, snake small.

Use case: stylized-concept. PRODUCTION RASTER MATERIALS for a premium Chinese wuxia desert RPG, matching reference pixel-art detail/palette. OUTPUT EXACTLY1536x1024, FULL BLEED six material samples in STRICT3columns x2rows, every cell512x512, zero margins, no gutters, no borders, no text, no props or objects, no perspective. Straight-down orthographic flat square textures, seamless opposing edges, crisp pixel clusters on logical2px grid, no smoothing. Top row left smooth golden sand with subtle fine grains and pale wind ripples; top middle rough ochre sand with small granular clumps and sparse pebbles; top right cracked dry earth with irregular umber fine cracks and dusty tan plates. Bottom row left rocky desert ground with low embedded sandstone gravel, walkable material no tall boulders; bottom middle warm worn square sandstone paving with fine chipped grout, aligned X/Y square grid, no diagonal or isometric stones; bottom right dune slope sand texture with shallow layered rippled ridges and amber shaded dune edges, top-down no horizon. Materials must share matching sand base colors, cohesive warm sand/chocolate shadows, light upper left, low contrast suitable combat floors. True small-pixel art matching Bamboo Forest material source quality. All six are independently reusable seamless material swatches, not concept illustrations.

Row2: horizontal ruined wall with Chinese fret relief; vertical north-south ruined wall segment; roofless ruined Chinese gateway with upturned lintel ends and red banner; ancient carved sandstone stele monument. Row3: gnarled leafless dead tree; small dry branching bush; wooden desert supply crate; squat wooden barrel. Row4: small crumbled temple facade with tiled upturned eaves; broken decorative stone guardian lion on plinth; scattered pebble ground decal small flat group; windblown dust/sand ground decal flat wisps. Keep bases compact, individual reusable sprites, not scenes and no connecting sand patches. Strong readable silhouettes and rich but crisp pixel shading. No creatures.
